年轻警察万分警惕的看着王野，王野不紧不慢的说道：“警察同志，不用紧张，我叫王野，四九城轧钢厂保卫科的，这次是出差来东北，这三个是小偷，你可以上前制服他们，再缴了我的枪。”

警察听了王野的话缓缓的向几人靠近，举着的枪始终没有放下。王野在警察靠近的时候提醒道：“小心，这几个货身上应该都有刀片！”

警察在离一步远点的地方停了下来，就在这时，车厢的两边进来六七个年轻的乘务员，领头的是一位中年汉子，四十多岁，他应该就是列车长。

列车长上前，跟年轻警察简单交流了两句，就指挥着众人把三个小偷绑了起来。列车长上前一步伸出右手：“同志，把你的枪先交出来吧。”

王野配合的把手枪反转过来，拿着枪管递给列车长。列车长做了个请的手势，引领着王野去了餐车。年轻警察和列车员们也押着三个小偷跟上。

到了餐车列车长：“同志，请你出示一下工作证和介绍信。”

王野从包里拿出东西递给他，列车长反复看了两遍说道：“王野同志，虽说你在保卫科工作，确实有配枪资格，但是你在火车上就拿出枪来是不是有点过了，要是走火了是多大的责任。”

王野一脸无所谓：“列车长同志，放心吧我还不至于这么肆无忌惮，我那把枪里没子弹。”

列车长一脸吃惊的拿起王野的手枪检查起来，这把枪里真的没有子弹。列车长把枪递给王野：“小王，你拿把没子弹的枪干什么？”

王野：“这不是要上火车了，提前把子弹卸了，毕竟是人群密集的地方，我也怕出点意外呀。”

列车长点点头：“小伙子谨慎，出门在外谨慎点好。”

说完招呼众人去审问几个小偷，又招呼王野坐下自我介绍道：“小王同志，我姓陆，是这列火车的列车长。你叫我陆叔就行。”

王野打招呼：“陆叔好，您也别同志同志的称呼我了，叫我小野就行。”

陆车长好奇的问道：“小野，你是怎么发现这三个小偷的？”

王野：“陆叔，不是我发现他们的，是那个老的拿着刀片要划我的包。我这包可是新的，能让他给划了。再说了，那刀片看着就锋利的很，万一这老家伙手一抖割到不该割的地方，我哭都没地方哭去。”

陆车长哈哈一笑：“你小子还割到不该割的地方，啥是不该割的地方呀？”

王野知道这是陆车长在调笑他：“大腿呀，这要是割到我大腿上得多疼呀。”

这回答把陆车长闪了一下，这和他想的不一样呀。点了点王野：“你小子脑子转的是真快呀。”

有闲聊了一会儿陆车长问道：“小野，你出差怎么单位没给你安排个卧铺呀？”

王野叹了口气说道：“陆叔别提了，我去买票的时候，没卧铺了这还是运气不错，买到张坐票，要不然我得站着回四九城。”

陆车长：“你咋不让对应单位给你买呀？”

王野：“这不是出差来东北，正好有点私事儿就请了两天假吗，去办完私事再麻烦人家多少有点说不过去不是。”

漂亮话谁不会说呀，这就是王野不认识对方工厂的人，他要是认识不麻烦人家才怪呢。

The young policeman looked at Wang Ye with great vigilance. Wang Ye said calmly: "Comrade police, don't be nervous. My name is Wang Ye. I am from the security department of the Sijiucheng Steel Rolling Mill. This time I am on a business trip to the Northeast. These three are thieves. You can step forward to subdue them and then hand over my gun."

After listening to Wang Ye's words, the police slowly approached the few people and never put down the gun they held.Wang Ye warned when the police approached: "Be careful, these guys should have blades on them!"

The police stopped a step away. At this moment, six or seven young stewards came in from both sides of the carriage. The leader was a middle-aged man in his forties. He should be the conductor.

The train conductor stepped forward, exchanged a few words with the young policeman briefly, and then directed everyone to tie up the three thieves.The conductor stepped forward and stretched out his right hand: "Comrade, please hand over your gun first."

Wang Ye cooperated and turned the pistol over, holding the barrel and handing it to the train conductor.The conductor made an inviting gesture and led Wang Ye to the dining car.The young policemen and train conductors also escorted the three thieves to follow.

When we arrived at the dining car, the conductor said: "Comrade, please show me your work ID and letter of introduction."

Wang Ye took something out of his bag and handed it to him. The train conductor looked at it twice and said, "Comrade Wang Ye, although you work in the security department and are indeed qualified to carry a gun, is it too much for you to take out a gun on the train? How much responsibility will you have if it goes off."

Wang Ye looked indifferent: "Comrade conductor, don't worry, I'm not so unscrupulous. There are no bullets in my gun."

The conductor looked surprised and picked up Wang Ye's pistol to check. There were really no bullets in the gun.The conductor handed the gun to Wang Ye: "Xiao Wang, what are you doing with a gun without bullets?"

Wang Ye: "It's time to get on the train. Unload the bullets in advance. After all, this is a crowded place, and I'm afraid of an accident."

The train conductor nodded: "Young man, be careful when you go out."

After saying that, he called everyone to interrogate a few thieves, and then called Wang Ye to sit down and introduce himself: "Comrade Xiao Wang, my surname is Lu, and I am the conductor of this train. Just call me Uncle Lu."

Wang Ye greeted: "Hello, Uncle Lu, please don't call me gay or comrade. Just call me Xiaoye."

Captain Lu asked curiously: "Xiaoye, how did you discover these three thieves?"

Wang Ye: "Uncle Lu, I wasn't the one who discovered them. It was the old man who was holding a razor blade to scratch my bag. My bag is new and he can scratch it. Besides, the blade looks very sharp. If this old guy shakes his hand and cuts somewhere he shouldn't, I won't have anywhere to cry."

Commander Lu laughed and said, "You still cut some places that you shouldn't have cut. What are the places you shouldn't have cut?"

Wang Ye knew that Commander Lu was teasing him: "Thigh, how painful it would be if it cut my thigh."

This answer dazzled Commander Lu. It was different from what he thought.Wang Ye nodded: "Your mind is spinning so fast."

After chatting for a while, Captain Lu asked: "Xiaoye, why didn't your company arrange a sleeper berth for you when you were on a business trip?"

Wang Ye sighed and said, "Uncle Lu, don't mention it. When I went to buy the ticket, there were no sleeper berths. I was lucky to get a seated ticket, otherwise I would have to stand back to Sijiu City."

Commander Lu: "Why don't you ask the corresponding unit to buy it for you?"

Wang Ye: "Isn't this a business trip to Northeast China? I just happened to have some personal matters, so I took two days off. It's a bit unreasonable to trouble others after finishing my personal matters."

Who doesn't know how to say nice things? This is because Wang Ye doesn't know the people in the other factory. It would be weird if he didn't bother them if he knew them.
